summary: Acceptance is blocked. The production wrapper silently overrides the shared five-claim gate with an incomplete three-claim list, omitting the primary intensity-width and concise-report claims. GUI paths enforce this weakened gate, while CLI and direct programmatic execution bypass it entirely. The live gate is closed, and the documented RC6 provenance validator fails because the production pipeline blob has changed substantially since the retained image evidence was generated.

evidence: `git rev-parse HEAD` returned `681a5f341709262d6ed2d473846d6432f7b7a03f`, exactly matching reviewed_commit.

`certutil -hashfile production_profiles\saturn_v5_7_1_model_c_epoch003.json SHA256` returned `a5bf553851c44a47772b70b1a08d95a532e1582714346010e33b6d98cf384dd8`, matching sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:495-499.

`certutil -hashfile model_checkpoints\v571_model_c_dual_head_epoch003.pt SHA256` returned `7d49031dbcce31f0600c44146d9b5282b0df6e28bb1fc1bdde6ef2146ed15d25`, matching production_profiles/saturn_v5_7_1_model_c_epoch003.json:30-32.
Validated-environment calls to `activate_default_production_profile`, `analysis_profile_review_state`, and `validate_analysis_runtime_config` reported `reviewed` and the expected checkpoint digest.

sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:500-510 replaces that default with a local three-claim tuple that omits both claims.

No CLI subprocess gate test was found by `rg -n "CLI|__main__|process_batch\(|process_one_image\(|production_audit_gate_state" tests -g '*.py'`.

The documented tuner self-check similarly stopped before exercising assertions with `PermissionError` while creating its temporary directory.
These are environment limitations, not passing test results.

findings.title: Production wrapper weakens the canonical audit gate
findings.impact: The application can label production readiness without requiring acceptance of the raw-signal FWHM measurement and concise biological-report claims that the shared service explicitly declares mandatory.
evidence: utils/saturn_v571_gui_services.py:36-44 contains five required claim IDs.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:500-510 passes a separate three-item tuple to the service, excluding `MEAS-INTENSITY-WIDTH-001` and `REPORT-BIOLOGIST-CONCISE-001`.
tests/test_saturn_v571_gate_hardening.py:47-57 tests only `SERVICES.PRODUCTION_REQUIRED_CLAIM_IDS`, allowing the production wrapper regression to pass unnoticed.
findings.recommendation: Remove the duplicate wrapper list and call the service with its canonical default, or import one immutable required-claim constant. Add a test against the actual pipeline wrapper requiring all five claims.

findings.title: CLI and programmatic execution bypass the GUI production gate
findings.impact: Identical analysis inputs are rejected by guarded GUI workflows but accepted through CLI or direct function calls, violating the claim that supported entry points share production semantics.
evidence: sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:19297-19301, 19504-19506, and 18565-18582 enforce GUI preflight.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:19753-19801 directly dispatches CLI single/batch execution after runtime validation without an audit-gate decision.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:16056-16138 exposes direct study execution without a production-gate check.
Repository search found no subprocess-level CLI test covering closed-gate refusal.
findings.recommendation: Enforce production readiness at a shared runner boundary used by GUI, CLI, batch, single-slice, and study execution. Add CLI subprocess and direct-runner tests for closed, malformed, and fully accepted registries.

findings.title: Retained image evidence is not bound to the reviewed pipeline blob
findings.impact: The preferred commit-bound validation cannot establish that current segmentation, measurement, tracking, GUI, and report behavior produced the retained evidence.
evidence: The documented provenance validator failed because the generated pipeline blob `1f56404b...` differs from current blob `021f6856...`.
audits/validation/v571_6f9e73b_validation.md:59-65 says the retained stage/tracking evidence applies only while the production pipeline blob remains unchanged.
The pipeline changed by 4,177 insertions and 1,053 deletions between the evidence commit and reviewed commit.
findings.recommendation: Generate new acceptance evidence from the reviewed pipeline or provide a narrowly scoped, independently validated replay binding for every affected output. Update the validation receipt only through a superseding append-only record.

findings.title: The live production gate is closed
findings.impact: The reviewed checkout cannot consistently be represented as a production candidate through its guarded GUI and report paths.
evidence: Live validated-environment gate evaluation returned false for `MEAS-BODY-WIDTH-001` and `WORKFLOW-GUI-PRIMARY-001`.
tests/test_saturn_v571_gate_hardening.py:147-153 explicitly expects the real repository registry to remain blocked.
tests/test_saturn_v571_gui_workflow.py:121-140 expects the reviewed profile to remain blocked by the scientific audit gate.
findings.recommendation: Do not accept this claim until all canonical prerequisite claims have superseding passing audits and the live gate opens without code or registry exceptions.

findings.title: Test suite provides false confidence about the real production gate
findings.impact: Strong fail-closed service tests can pass while the application supplies a weaker dependency list and while unguarded CLI execution remains available.
evidence: tests/test_saturn_v571_gate_hardening.py:37-153 thoroughly tests the service in isolation.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:500-510 overrides the tested service default.
No test found invokes the actual `__main__` CLI dispatcher under a closed audit gate.
findings.recommendation: Prioritize boundary tests over source-string or helper-only assertions: invoke the real wrapper, CLI dispatcher, GUI callbacks, and study runner against the same synthetic registries.

limitations: No full image stack or expensive image inference was run, as instructed.
Focused tests and tuner self-check could not run because the read-only environment provided no writable temporary directory.
GUI behavior was traced through source and existing tests; no interactive Tk session was launched.
The current untracked audit-run directory was not read as another reviewer's output.
recommended_follow_up: Unify the required-claim list and production gate at one shared execution boundary.
Add integration tests covering CLI single, CLI batch, GUI preview, GUI batch, tuner launch/profile loading, study execution, and report generation under both closed and accepted gates.
Regenerate or independently rebind acceptance evidence to commit 681a5f341709262d6ed2d473846d6432f7b7a03f, then rerun `validate_v571_evidence_provenance.py`.
Rerun the focused and full validated-environment suites in a writable audit workspace before requesting a superseding review.
